rows.en: The Drake Army has recently been seen abducting people of the Surface in many places.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: With the joint E2 project come to nothing, they seem to have turned against the UCE.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: It's no exaggeration to say they have begun a full-scale invasion of the surface.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: We <mk(81.5,37.5,7,0,1)><ar(0,7,0,100)>will now change course and move to support the Gran Garan.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: We may be forced to fight underwater. Prepare to sortie with that in mind.
rows.speaker: Ra Cailum briefing officer

rows.en: Drake's plan to seize people of the Surface failed, and the captives were safely freed.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana

rows.en: I'd say we have, for now, stopped their scheme to use people of the Surface in war.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana

rows.en: It is regrettable that Drake escaped, but we must not be hasty for results now.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana

rows.en: I must, without fail, send Drake back to Byston Well.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana

rows.en: To that end, we too intend to spare no effort in cooperating with you.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana

rows.en: With weak strength, you cannot fight to the end. You must hone yourselves further.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?
